paths.title: AI for E-commerce Owners
paths.tagline: From product descriptions that convert to automating your store's recurring content work.
paths.description: A 6-lesson path for e-commerce owners covering the AI workflows that move the needle in a real store: writing product descriptions that sell without overclaiming, generating genuinely distinct ad copy for A/B testing, creating on-brand product and lifestyle photos with AI image tools, handling refund, delay, and complaint replies accurately, building welcome, abandoned-cart, and post-purchase email flows, and automating recurring content work with a human approval checkpoint.

paths.title: AI for Customer Support
paths.tagline: From rewriting one difficult reply to designing a full triage workflow your team can trust.
paths.description: A 6-lesson path for customer support professionals covering the AI skills that make a team faster without sacrificing accuracy or tone: rewriting difficult replies to be firm and kind, building a macro library from your own best replies, turning resolved tickets into knowledge-base articles, writing escalation summaries for engineers and managers, keeping tone consistent across a growing team, and designing an AI-assisted triage workflow that keeps judgment calls with a human.
